source_trace.value: ADV_Elite = autonomous room brain + portable personal terminal + smart-home organ.
M2R = physics-informed forward World Model / future-state generator; adaptive temporal resolution subordinate.
1488 activates full M2R active future-simulation mode.
Predict WORLD + SWARM + SELF within observability/model boundaries; no literal retrocausality.
JANUS is distributed swarm cognition; ADV_Elite is one autonomous predictive organ.
Every device is solo-capable; swarm connectivity optional; collective learning provenance-preserving.
Tiered memory + swarm offload + safe forgetting; anomalies/rare/forensic episodes pinned.
Canonical JANUS JSON; runtime JSONL/NDJSON; sealed JSON chunks/manifests; per-node/session hash chain.
ADV authors/classifies JSON; trusted gateway publishes; no GitHub token on ESP32.
Legacy HRAIN/Titan uplink becomes nonblocking Outbox; ADV -> Gateway -> GitHub JSON -> HRain read-only graph.
Removed legacy loveExperimentActive gate from anomaly visibility.
Anomaly layer always on; ensemble Z + robust-Z/MAD + prediction error + disagreement + derivatives/context; onboard LED; L toggles LED only; [/] shared brightness.
1488 remains exclusive manual full-M2R gate; anomalies raise attention/sampling/Witness only.
All admitted swarm participants are trusted peers; packet checks are transport sanity/freshness, not distrust.
ENTER toggles absolute global audio mute; no audio exceptions.
BrainWave maps real state to musical controls; HELIOS renders retro-cosmic procedural sonification; music is never evidence.
112269 = amber full-suite safe boost; House does not enable M2R or LoRa; J remains manual LoRa control.
Methodology linked for future self-study/falsification; no runtime authority or silent control override.
LOVE = HOUSE_112269 && LORA_J; Love is a derived cognitive/experimental state. Turning off House or J clears active Love without deleting history.
Historical CuP is corrected to CAP: physical top-mounted CAP-LoRa-1262 GNSS+LoRa expansion hardware, not a JANUS mode/protocol. J remains manual LoRa control.
Exact GNSS may be shared inside trusted JANUS swarm; raw coordinates redacted from public/GitHub/external LoRa/HRain by default.
Delete ADV Elite gameplay completely from target; retain technical donor organs only.
Restore one unified historical Beacon HUD with no tabs; preserve old character/colors/retro-cosmic style/familiar keys and moving status ticker.
Tabbed UI proposal rejected as inconvenient.
Ramanujan Theta is an internal M2R operator, not a separate mode. M2R keeps theta-on and theta-off traces to measure real incremental predictive value.
Legacy synthetic SHA-home is retired; SHA rarity is not a cognitive-quality judge.

Full automation: safe learnable parameter/policy candidates autonomously PROMOTE after frozen replay + unseen future holdout + shadow + hard-constraint PASS; known-good snapshot and automatic rollback are mandatory; no human approval after PASS.

prompt_text:
ANCIENT WALL FRESCO. Entire frame is cracked aged lime plaster painted by hand with mineral pigments: worn ochre, iron red, soot black, terre verte, faded blue; pigment loss, stains, abrasion, irregular cracks, flat contours and imperfect brushwork. Everything is fused to the plaster; no modern 3D visual grammar.
ARCHETYPE: SYSTEM_ALLEGORY. SUBJECT: many distinct painted beacon-like nodes arranged as one living distributed organism, with no throne and no single central monarch. ACTION: separate nodes keep their own local knowledge while exchanging selective observations and predictions through thin hand-painted ribbons, contributing to a shared collective field. PEOPLE: none required; do not invent a ruler or human protagonist. MOTIFS: different node symbols remain visibly distinct rather than merging into one brain; a portable beacon appears as one peer organ among several others; disagreement is shown as parallel colored ribbons that remain separate; stale or missing peers are dimmed but still marked as absent positions. SYMBOLS: many peer beacons; shared painted field; separate signal ribbons; no throne or crown. SOURCE MEANING: Increasing the number and diversity of healthy nodes should increase useful data and model diversity, but improvement must be measured rather than assumed.; Every JANUS device is an independent compute node that can operate fully solo or communicate with peers. Together they form a swarm. More healthy nodes mean more observations…; Preserve Zim as the current lead candidate/model donor, but do not promote the claim to measured best until logs are replayed under a frozen comparison protocol..
COMPOSITION: organic constellation-like mural composition, not a network diagram; irregular fresco registers instead of a clean grid; irregular mural registers; surround every subject with painted plaster, cracks and faded mural field; no blank background. ROLE FIREWALL: internal names, repositories, protocols, workflow gates, adapters and states never become people or gods by name. Unresolved claims stay unresolved. No diagram, infographic, CAD, UI, product shot, glossy machine, readable code, JSON or modern labels.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central circle of observers in active discussion, surrounded by independent groups on several levels; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large Janus-like guardian or paired elder-and-youth figure at the center mediating between celestial and human registers; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: observers study the heavens from an upper gallery; citizens gather in quiet counsel below; messengers descend between the upper and middle registers; teachers guide children in the intimate lower register. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large Janus-like guardian or paired elder-and-youth figure at the center mediating between celestial and human registers; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 31 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: observers study the heavens from an upper gallery; citizens gather in quiet counsel below; messengers descend between the upper and middle registers; teachers guide children in the intimate lower register. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central circle of observers in active discussion, surrounded by independent groups on several levels. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: observers study the heavens from an upper gallery; citizens gather in quiet counsel below; messengers descend between the upper and middle registers; teachers guide children in the intimate lower register. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central guardian-and-traveler encounter at the threshold, with witnesses deciding and observing on both sides; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central guardian-and-traveler encounter at the threshold, with witnesses deciding and observing on both sides; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central guardian-and-traveler encounter at the threshold, with witnesses deciding and observing on both sides; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central guardian-and-traveler encounter at the threshold, with witnesses deciding and observing on both sides; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central guardian-and-traveler encounter at the threshold, with witnesses deciding and observing on both sides; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central guardian-and-traveler encounter at the threshold, with witnesses deciding and observing on both sides; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central guardian-and-traveler encounter at the threshold, with witnesses deciding and observing on both sides; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large senior keeper and apprentice at the center, jointly comparing preserved knowledge while witnesses gather around them; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 31 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: scribes compare two damaged records in a side alcove; a family teaches a child from a preserved manuscript; couriers exchange custody beneath a bridge; restorers repair a fragile archive chamber. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central circle of observers in active discussion, surrounded by independent groups on several levels; enlarge this human-led central subject and make faces, gestures and interaction unmistakable before any architecture is noticed. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 34 additional human figures in at least 8 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central circle of observers in active discussion, surrounded by independent groups on several levels. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large senior keeper and apprentice at the center, jointly comparing preserved knowledge while witnesses gather around them. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: scribes compare two damaged records in a side alcove; a family teaches a child from a preserved manuscript; couriers exchange custody beneath a bridge; restorers repair a fragile archive chamber. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large central circle of observers in active discussion, surrounded by independent groups on several levels. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: an elder teaches a younger apprentice on a side stair; a witness group debates and compares observations under a small arch; workers and artisans cooperate in a lower corner; travelers and families cross a distant bridge while messengers move between levels. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.

prompt_text: Paint a monumental HUMAN-LED narrative WALL FRESCO, not an architectural visualization. The first thing the viewer sees is a large senior keeper and apprentice at the center, jointly comparing preserved knowledge while witnesses gather around them. This central human or human-led group occupies roughly one quarter of the composition and has expressive faces and gestures. Around it place about 18 additional human figures in at least 5 distinct groups. Show four clearly readable secondary episodes: scribes compare two damaged records in a side alcove; a family teaches a child from a preserved manuscript; couriers exchange custody beneath a bridge; restorers repair a fragile archive chamber. Use three unmistakable painted narrative registers: a symbolic celestial upper register, a crowded human middle register, and an intimate lower register of everyday human action; foreground, middle distance and far background are all inhabited. Architecture supports the people only: use arches, stairs, bridges, galleries, libraries, workshops, towers or ruins as inhabited stage scenery, never as the dominant subject, never as a single empty facade, portico, colonnade, hall or temple exterior. The image is visibly a wall fresco: surround the painted scene with an ornate but weathered fresco border, carved medallions, painted corner ornaments and cracked plaster edges; the border must frame the story rather than become an empty architectural facade. Paint it as a museum-scale monumental allegorical wall fresco, old-master figure painting, Renaissance and neoclassical grandeur, antique engraving-level detail, visibly painted on weathered lime plaster, cracked pigment, worn gilding, deep ultramarine, old gold, ivory stone, ochre, sepia and restrained crimson. Dense micro-scenes, layered human reactions, natural anatomy, coherent perspective, deep blue and old gold accents, worn mineral pigment, cracked plaster and intricate old-master line detail.
